data.help: avg = average of the latest value of every ping task on the node; primary = show the primary task below; latest = the single most recent ping record; window = average of real records inside the window below. / avg：该节点全部测速任务最新值的平均；primary：显示下方选定的主任务；latest：最近一条真实测速记录；window：下方时间窗口内真实记录的平均。
Used when the mode is primary; the first selected task wins. Nodes without that task fall back to avg. / 取值方式为 primary 时生效，取第一个选中的任务；没有该任务的节点回退到 avg。
Tasks listed here are shown as the v4 line of the LATENCY cell; tasks whose name contains v4/IPv4 are detected automatically too. / 在此选中的任务在 LATENCY 格里显示为 v4 一行；任务名含 v4/IPv4 也会自动识别。
Tasks listed here are shown as the v6 line of the LATENCY cell; tasks whose name contains v6/IPv6 are detected automatically too. / 在此选中的任务在 LATENCY 格里显示为 v6 一行；任务名含 v6/IPv6 也会自动识别。
Used when the mode is window; 1-60. / 取值方式为 window 时生效，1–60。
Latency below this value gets a green dot. / 延迟低于此值显示绿点。
Latency below this value gets an amber dot, otherwise a red dot. / 延迟低于此值显示黄点，否则红点。

description.en: NodeScope for Komari: a dense, monospace LTstats-style monitor theme with sortable list view, card view with live trends, and SVG detail charts.
description.zh: NodeScope 的 Komari 移植版：LTstats 风格的等宽密集监控主题，支持可排序列表视图、带实时趋势火花线的卡片视图，以及内联 SVG 详情大图。
